newsitem.title: USA: China Pacific Q1 net falls.
newsitem.headline: China Pacific Q1 net falls.

text.p: China Pacific Inc Thursday said gross profit for the first quarter of 1997 was $3.6 million vs. $4.1 million for the first quarter of 1996.
For the first quarter ended March 31, 1997, net sales increased 7.4 percent to $30.3 million from $28.2 million, compared with the corresponding period of last year.
The company said the primary reason for the decrease in gross profit was an increase in the cost of raw materials.

Net income for the first quarter of 1997 was $1.0 million, or 12 cents per share, vs. $3.1 million, or 43 cents per share, for the corresponding period in 1996. The further decline in net income from the prior year was due to the ending of the minimum profit guarantee from the company's Chinese joint venture partner to its principal subsidiary, China Pacific Steel Ltd.
